hints.title: Column-by-Column Digit Arithmetic
hints.text: Rather than assigning digits to all letters at once, evaluate addition column by column from units place to leading digits with carry.

hints.title: Leading Zero Restriction Check
hints.text: Leading letters of any multi-digit word or result cannot be mapped to digit 0.

hints.title: Backtracking with Column Sum Verification
hints.text: When moving to the next column, verify sum of column digits plus carry matches target digit modulo 10.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(10! / (10 - U)!) bounded by column pruning
variables: U: number of unique letters (at most 10)
complexity.notes: Column-wise pruning reduces search state from 10! to a fraction of branches.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all digit permutations without column verification explores 10! combinations that fail early on units place.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Column-first backtracking prunes invalid assignments immediately after verifying each decimal position.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Column-wise addition backtracking with carry propagation and non-zero constraints.
